detail.transcribed: Transcribed the 4 s probe in {{a}} ms
detail.classified: Classified the probe clip in {{a}} ms
detail.storage: Wrote and read back a test object in {{a}} ms
detail.roundTrip: Completed a 24-token round trip in {{a}} ms

providers.title: AI providers
providers.description: Named connections for each capability. Workspaces use the default of each capability unless an operator assigns another connection.

encryption.title: Key encryption is active
encryption.body: Keys are sealed with the platform key before they are stored. The full value is never returned by the API; only a masked hint is shown, and a key can be replaced or removed but never read back.

empty.title: No {{capability}} connections
empty.body: Create a connection to give workspaces a {{capability}} provider.
empty.bodyActive: There are no active connections here. Turn on “Show inactive” to see paused ones, or create a new connection.

deactivate.title: Deactivate “{{name}}”?
deactivate.body: Workspaces assigned to this connection fall back to the default for its capability. You can reactivate it at any time.

form.description: Pick a provider from the catalog, a model, and add the key. The key is write-only.
form.name: Name
form.modelHint: No known models for this provider. Type the model name.
form.baseUrlHint: Optional. Only needed for gateways and self-hosted servers.
form.apiKeyStored: A key is stored ({{hint}}). Type a new one to replace it.
form.apiKeyHint: Write-only. Stored encrypted, shown as a masked hint afterwards.
form.settingsHint: Optional key/value parameters passed to the provider, such as temperature.
form.errName: Give the connection a name (at least 2 characters).
form.errUrl: Enter a full http(s) address, for example https://host/v1.
form.errUrlRequired: A self-hosted endpoint needs a base URL.
form.errSettingKey: Setting names start with a letter and use letters, digits and underscores.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Instructions shared by every analysis, a health check of the whole AI chain, transcription defaults and the credentials used by the web chat service.

instructions.title: Analysis instructions
instructions.description: Added to every analyser prompt, for every workspace. Use it for house rules that apply to all calls.
instructions.label: Global instructions
instructions.hint: Plain language. Workspace rubrics and knowledge bases still decide the verdicts.
instructions.placeholder: e.g. Judge only what the agent actually says. Treat prices as correct only if the knowledge base states them.

selfTest.title: Connection self-test
selfTest.description: Runs a probe against every link in the chain and reports each result in order.
selfTest.quickNote: Quick: one lightweight call per service.
selfTest.deepNote: Deep: also checks the knowledge-base index, chat credentials and the job queue, and does a full round trip on the language model.

transcription.title: Transcription defaults
transcription.description: The operator layer. A workspace can override these in its own settings; a single upload can override both.
transcription.languageHint: Naming the language avoids detection mistakes on short calls.
transcription.format: Audio format sent to the engine
transcription.formatHint: Smaller formats upload faster; lossless keeps every detail.
transcription.diarizeHint: Label who is speaking. Needed for agent and customer scoring.
transcription.keytermsHint: Names, products and jargon the engine should expect. One per line or separated by commas.
transcription.errChars: “{{term}}” contains a character that is not allowed.
transcription.errLong: “{{term}}” is too long. Keep a term under {{chars}} characters and {{words}} words.
transcription.layers: Order of precedence: built-in values, then this default, then the workspace’s own setting, then the individual file.

chat.title: Web chat credentials
chat.description: How the web chat service signs in to Sinji. Each credential has scopes, per-workspace grants and secrets that can be rotated without downtime.

empty.title: No credentials yet
empty.body: Create one to let the web chat service ask Sinji for suggestions and answers.

overlap.title: Rotation in progress
overlap.body: The previous secret keeps working until {{date}} ({{days}} days left), so the web chat service can switch over without downtime.

grants.title: Workspace grants
grants.none: No workspace has been granted access yet.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate the secret of “{{name}}”?
rotateDialog.body: A new secret is created and shown once. The current secret stays valid for 7 more days so you can update the web chat service, then it expires on its own.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke {{key}}?
revokeDialog.body: The secret stops working immediately. Calls signed with it will be rejected. This cannot be undone.

secretDialog.label: Secret
secretDialog.overlap: The old secret stays valid until {{date}}.

form.editDescription: Change the name, the scopes or which workspaces may be reached.
form.createDescription: A secret is generated when you create it and shown once.
form.name: Name
form.scopesHint: What the credential may do at most. Grants can narrow this per workspace.
form.grantsHint: The workspaces this credential may reach, and with which scopes.
form.noGrants: No workspaces yet. Without a grant the credential reaches nothing.
form.errName: Give the credential a name (at least 2 characters).

scopes.chat_turn: Run a chat turn for a customer.
scopes.chat_suggest: Ask for suggested replies for an operator.
scopes.chat_answer: Send a finished answer back into the conversation.

diagnose.title: Diagnose a credential
diagnose.description: Check whether a key of “{{name}}” would be accepted for a workspace, and if not, why.
diagnose.keyIdHint: The key id the web chat service sends. Pick one below or type any id.

ok.title: Accepted
ok.explain: The key is valid, the credential is switched on, the workspace has an active grant and the scope is covered. Requests will go through.

unknown_key_id.title: Unknown key id
unknown_key_id.explain: This credential has no secret with that id. The web chat service may be using a typo, or a key from another credential.
unknown_key_id.fix: Copy the key id from the secrets table above, or create a new secret by rotating.

secret_revoked.title: Secret revoked
secret_revoked.explain: The secret was revoked and is rejected immediately.
secret_revoked.fix: Rotate the credential and give the new secret to the web chat service.

secret_expired.title: Secret expired
secret_expired.explain: The secret passed its end of life, usually the end of a rotation overlap.
secret_expired.fix: Update the web chat service to the current secret, or rotate again.

no_grant.title: No grant for this workspace
no_grant.explain: The credential is fine, but this workspace has not been granted to it, or the grant is switched off.
no_grant.fix: Edit the credential and add or enable the workspace under grants.

scope_missing.title: Scope missing
scope_missing.explain: The workspace is granted, but the grant does not include the scope that was asked for.
scope_missing.fix: Edit the credential and tick the scope for this workspace.

tenant_inactive.title: Workspace is inactive
tenant_inactive.explain: The workspace has been deactivated, so no credential can reach it.
tenant_inactive.fix: Reactivate the workspace in Console > Workspaces.

integration_inactive.title: Credential is switched off
integration_inactive.explain: The whole credential is inactive, so every key of it is rejected.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.description: The model that turns knowledge-base text and questions into vectors for retrieval.
embeddings.baseUrlHint: Required for a self-hosted server, optional otherwise.
embeddings.dimHint: Vector length. Must match what the model returns.
embeddings.apiKeyStored: A key is stored ({{hint}}). Type a new one to replace it.
embeddings.apiKeyHint: Write-only. Not needed for a self-hosted server without authentication.
embeddings.warnBody_one: Vectors of {{from}} dimensions cannot be compared with {{to}}-dimension vectors. After saving, {{count}} indexed chunk must be embedded again.
embeddings.warnBody_other: Vectors of {{from}} dimensions cannot be compared with {{to}}-dimension vectors. After saving, {{count}} indexed chunks must be embedded again.
embeddings.sideNote: Changing the model or the dimension affects every workspace. Re-embed each knowledge base from its Maintenance page afterwards.
embeddings.confirmBody_one: The dimension goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Stored vectors become unusable, and {{count}} indexed chunk has to be re-imported or re-embedded before retrieval is accurate again.
embeddings.confirmBody_other: The dimension goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Stored vectors become unusable, and {{count}} indexed chunks have to be re-imported or re-embedded before retrieval is accurate again.
embeddings.savedReimport: Saved. Re-import the knowledge bases to use the new dimension.
embeddings.errDim: The dimension is a whole number between 8 and 8192.
embeddings.errUrl: Enter a full http(s) address, for example https://host/v1.
embeddings.errUrlRequired: A self-hosted endpoint needs a base URL.

setup.title: AI setup
setup.description: Which connection each workspace uses for language, transcription and speech.
setup.noDefaultCard: No default. Workspaces without their own connection have nothing to use.
setup.legend: Bold means the workspace has its own connection assigned. Grey means it inherits the default. “Own key” marks a workspace that brings its own key.
setup.tableCaption: Workspaces and the connection in effect for each capability
setup.noMatchesBody: Try a different name or connection.

tenant.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list.
tenant.description: Choose a connection for each capability, or keep the default.
tenant.assignmentsHint: Default follows whatever is the default for the capability, now and later.
tenant.byoWins: The workspace’s own key takes precedence over this choice.
tenant.inactiveNote: This workspace is inactive. Changes are kept but nothing runs until it is reactivated.

legacy.title: Text-AI override (legacy)
legacy.description: An older per-workspace setting for the language model. When enabled it replaces the default for text analysis. Prefer a connection above.
legacy.enabledHint: Applies to language-model calls of this workspace.
legacy.keyStored: A key is stored ({{hint}}). Type a new one to replace it.
legacy.removeBody: The override is switched off and the key is deleted. The workspace falls back to its connection or the default.
legacy.errKey: Add a key to enable the override.
